description: Public-sector contracts a UK company has been awarded. From Contracts Finder and Find a Tender award notices — count, notified value (contracts and framework ceilings apart; `contracts.withoutValue` counts awards with no published value), top buyers and the latest awards (the lots of one notice as one line with `lots`; a notice published on both feeds once, the other under `alsoNotified`). Matched by company number where a notice gives one (both feeds' numbers read since 10 Oct 2026), else by exact registered name. 1 credit. Use this for public-sector awards the company has won; public_record carries a summary of the same.

company.description: A UK company number (8 characters, such as 00502851 or SC123456) is surest; a name also works and goes to the closest registered company, which the reply names. Use company_search first when a name could mean several companies.
